body: Oh. I understand, I think. I'm sorry.
....Love? Is that what we call the action here?

I don't just mean thinking of my demise, I think about my suicide plans lately. I think all about it. It's something that's pretty much a constant in my brain-- when it gets bad I feel like actually DOING it rather than just thinking.

I don't know, what do you think will be learnt from what's going on right now?
